text:
Maria Chen: Tiny Tuesday! Artemis came to the office today and discovered the ficus. She tried to nap in the pot. Pics below --> https://imgur.com/abcd1234 (one is literally a plant-pot nap 😂). Who else brought pets today?
Samir Patel: This is illegal levels of cute :heart_eyes:
Jonah Ruiz: Plant-pot nap = new startup idea: 'Potter' :seedling::dog:
Priya Nair: Aaaa I'm allergic but this is adorable. Can I get one pic for my wallpaper? 🙏
Samir Patel: Here's a high-res download: https://files.redwood-internal/pets/artemis_wallpaper.jpg (for non-allergic users only)
Erin Lowe: Artemis is an absolute unit. Those ears! :raised_hands:
Maria Chen: Quick PSA: Artemis is micro-trained, please don't feed her the hummus in the kitchen :)
deploy-bot: :paw_prints: Artemis has been added to the #random-pets gallery (auto-tagged: dog, office).
Priya Nair: Bookmarking these for the 3pm slump — thanks Maria! :coffee:
Samir Patel: Vote: Artemis or Stanley (Jonah's cat) for office mascot? :ballot_box_with_check:
Jonah Ruiz: Stanley sends regards and will retaliate with a laser pointer on Friday.
Maria Chen: Haha, may the best floof win. Also posting a close-up (cute snoot alert) in the thread.
Erin Lowe: mandatory reaction: :heart: :heart: :heart:
Priya Nair: Also true fact: dogs are better at listening during standups.
Samir Patel: Evidence? Asking for a friend.
Maria Chen: 1) treats 2) eyes 3) actually sits through the whole standup. Confirmed.
Jonah Ruiz: OK now I'm trying to train my cat to attend standup via webcam. Will report back.
Maria Chen: Follow-up: Artemis will be in the office again Thursday for anyone who wants to say hi (and keep hummus in your own desk drawers). :smile:
